name: auctra
description: Auctra — real-time online auction platform (React, Node.js, MySQL, Redis, Socket.IO)

scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit -w backend && npm run test:integration -w backend && npm run test:concurrency -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
